payload.title: Related stories block at the bottom of a story (derived first, explicit links later)
payload.description: Ryan 2026-11-09 asks to associate stories with each other and articles with posts, shown formatted at the bottom of a story. Today: SemanticRelation allows item-to-item links but only generic related_to (plus evidence types supports/contradicts/derived_from); no editorial types, no write path, no front-end block. Step 1: derive Related from shared accepted References (based_on/cited) and shared concepts, ranked by overlap; articles as picture cards, posts as compact brief rows; same data seam as the concepts row. Step 2: add explicit relation types (expands_on / goes deeper in, follows_up) with inverse labels, a CLI/newsroom/agent write path, and let explicit links outrank derived ones.
